Exact signed integral chain projection of the two critical five-cell boundaries onto the unique critical four-cell gives the zero 1-by-2 degree matrix. A Morse CW model with one vertex, one four-cell and two five-cells therefore has nullhomotopic attachments via pi_4(S^4)=Z, yielding S^4 wedge S^5 wedge S^5. The original mod-two boundary ranks independently corroborate Betti ranks without being used for integral inference.
